+def quota_solver(data):
+    from itertools import combinations
+
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    available = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+
+    for subset in combinations(available, k):
+        ids = {job["id"] for job in subset}
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in subset:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        events = []
+        for job in subset:
+            events.append((job["start"], 1))
+            events.append((job["end"], -1))
+        active = 0
+        valid = True
+        for _, change in sorted(events):  # end (-1) precedes start at shared endpoint
+            active += change
+            if active > 2:
+                valid = False
+                break
+        if not valid:
+            continue
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in subset)
+        selected = sorted(ids)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and selected < best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, selected
+
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
+
